target: ConPort: required instance_id on writes with the explicit `shared` instance, the workspace binding check, auth middleware with modes on every tool-serving surface, the principal column with an operator-run migration, and the transport W00 chose for Codex (design 5.1, 5.4, 5.5, 5.9, W2).
invariants: C01 Shared workspace: other workers may edit this checkout. Edit only your write_surface; preserve others' edits; never revert unrelated work. Work only in the execution worktree .worktrees/runner-memory-2a on feat/runner-memory-2a (base 97b6d5040496e2271c41d24c339d039303bbe6b1); verify `git rev-parse --show-toplevel` and the branch before the first write.

C02 You never commit, push, merge, open a PR, mark ready, sign, tag, change git config or rewrite history. The team lead alone commits (one commit per workstream, explicit pathspec) after re-reading your diff.

C03 ADVISOR FORBIDDEN (budget 0): do not call the `advisor` tool and do not spawn subagents or delegate. advisor_calls is a required return field and must be 0; a nonzero count is a contract breach and the status becomes NEEDS_SUPERVISOR.

C04 Secrets: never read or print .env*, credential files, keychain items, bearer tokens or token hashes from a real install; never write a real secret into a file, test fixture, log or return. Tests use obviously fake values generated in the test (for example 'test-token-<n>'). Log a principal name, never a token or an Authorization header.

C05 Truth buckets: report PASS / FAIL / NOT_RUN / UNKNOWN literally; never collapse NOT_RUN into PASS. Anything live that you did not observe is NOT_RUN. The conport, dope-memory and serena MCP connectors were unreachable in the issuing session (a Docker outage on 2026-10-30, since recovered): do not invent endpoints, tool names, request fields, settings or ports. Use only interfaces this packet names or that you confirm in source with file:line; otherwise write UNKNOWN.

C06 Return fields: status (exactly one of READY_FOR_AUDIT, BLOCKED, NEEDS_SUPERVISOR, INCOMPLETE), subject, validation (command, exit code, bucket), proof, audit (NOT_RUN: the single final audit is held by the supervisor), blockers (each with the action that clears it), advisor_calls, files_written, observed_model (from a runtime receipt, else UNKNOWN).

C07 Stop and return evidence instead of improvising when: a needed file is outside your write_surface; a contract-sensitive surface outside your write_surface (schema, hook registration, MCP manifest, compose service definition) would change; a required fact is UNKNOWN; or validation still fails after one fix attempt for the same cause (no cheap-model repair loop).

C08 Authority order: this packet, then runtime code, then schemas, then tests, then docs. The design is docs/91-rfc/rfc-2026-10-30-runner-memory-parity-2a.md (sha256 1fea60130d55d151dfbc70eb24571efb90c8ecee9e9183a05f3beb0915970cd3); it states intent, not runtime facts. Where the design and runtime code disagree, STOP and report; do not pick one silently. No workstream edits the design file.

C09 Evidence input: proof/MACRO-DMX-RUNNER-MEMORY-2A-001/review_bundle/W00_FINDINGS.md is the W00 result this workstream is sized from. The team lead commits it at J01-GATE and passes you its sha256 at dispatch; if the file's hash differs, STOP. GATE_TABLE.workstream_go for this workstream must be GO or GO_REDUCED (otherwise STOP: the team lead should not have dispatched you); its GATE_TABLE.reductions are binding. If any GATE_TABLE.design_changes entry lists this workstream, STOP: the supervisor issues a revision (R2) instead.

C10 No live mutation: never start, stop, restart or rebuild a container; never run `dopemux mcp start|up|init`, `docker compose`, a migration against a real database, `dopemux auth issue|rotate|revoke`, or the orchestrator cutover; never write the keychain, ~/.config/dopemux/ or any file outside the worktree (global runner configs included). Tests use temp directories, fakes and a stubbed `security` subprocess.

C11 Python 3.12 through the repo Makefile/uv (`uv run --frozen --extra test pytest ...`); the harness python3 may be 3.9 and is not evidence. New tests go in this workstream's own directory under tests/unit/ (CI runs tests/unit, tests/arch, tests/dcp, tests/integration; services/*/tests and docker/*/tests are not run by CI). Each new test directory carries an empty __init__.py.

A01 PROPOSED allowances for this workstream (caps, not forecasts; the operator accepts them by authorizing the macro): elapsed wall time 120 min from dispatch; subagent tokens 1,500,000; tool uses 300; child attempts: 1 attempt + 1 retry; team-lead review rounds: 1 diff re-read + at most 1 correction round. Active (model-working) time is not separately recordable by the harness: UNKNOWN; elapsed is the enforceable bound.

A02 The team lead reads the recordable counters from the child's completion notice (duration_ms, subagent_tokens, tool_uses) and records them with the return. A retry is allowed only after a failed validation with a named cause and only once; a second failure, any exceeded cap or any advisor call ends the workstream.

A03 When a cap is hit: stop the workstream, start no further attempt, preserve the uncommitted diff untouched, and return NEEDS_SUPERVISOR with the counters and the evidence. No model upgrade, provider change or extra attempt without a new operator ruling.

B01 Writes means every mutating tool on the SSE surface (including the SSE-only fork_instance, promote and promote_all), every mutating tool on the REST JSON-RPC surface, and the REST routes POST /api/decisions, /api/progress, /api/custom_data, /api/context/{ws} and PUT /api/progress/{id} (W00 Q7 is the full list).
B02 Shared data (design 5.1, supervisor's call): a write with no instance_id is rejected; instance_id `shared` lands where NULL lands today; existing NULL rows read as `shared`; no row is rewritten.

B03 Binding check and auth middleware as in design 5.1 and 5.5: modes off / log / enforce from one env setting, SHA-256 of the bearer token compared in constant time with the read-only hash file, principal or `unverified` stored, header never logged. Applies to every tool-serving surface.

B04 Transport (design 5.4): follow GATE_TABLE.conport_transport.choice. STREAMABLE_HTTP_APP: add a streamable-HTTP app beside `sse_app()` in server.py serving the same tools; the SSE surface stays. REST_JSONRPC: change nothing in transport. UNKNOWN: STOP.

B05 Migration: add the principal column (nullable, default `unverified`) through the existing migration mechanism, with a rollback script. It runs only as an operator step; never on container start. Document the known migration-gate deadlock workaround for W07.

B06 compose.yml: only the ConPort service's environment, a read-only mount of the host hash directory, and a published port for the streamable-HTTP app if B04 adds one (use the per-worktree port variable pattern already in compose.yml; W06 updates the catalog). No other service changes.

B07 Tests: missing instance_id rejected, `shared` accepted, workspace mismatch rejected, each mode with valid/invalid/missing tokens on both surfaces, principal stored, SSE-only write tools covered, migration up and down against the schema text (no live Postgres).
